bead.title: Hybrid-async perf gates + profile attribution
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The suite gates only the ack/claim ratio, recovery, and disk-loss; it never gates segment density or object PUT volume, never bounds async SQLite apply-debt over time, and never attributes where hot-path time is spent (SQLite, locks, fsync, scheduler, serialization), so a passing row cannot prove the hybrid-async success barrier.
ROOT CAUSE: emit_ledger at crates/pqueue-server/tests/performance_object_log_hybrid_tests.rs:560 computes bars_met from only ack_ratio<=1.20 && claim_ratio<=1.20 && recovery && disk_loss; the segment-density fields (segments_sealed/objects_put/mean_commands_per_segment/max_commands_per_segment) are emitted around crates/pqueue-server/tests/performance_object_log_hybrid_tests.rs:596 but are ungated; there is no attribution timer for serialization, lock-wait, fsync/commit, SQLite apply, or scheduler yield, and no time-series of SQLite apply lag / sqlite_high_water.
PROPOSED FIX: (a) add per-phase attribution timers surfaced as ledger fields hybrid_attr_{serialize,lock_wait,fsync,sqlite_apply,scheduler}_ms, drawing on the WAL/synchronous=NORMAL group-commit projection documented at crates/pqueue-sqlite/src/relational.rs:4344 and the composed flush at crates/pqueue-objectlog/src/segmented.rs:703; (b) add a bounded-debt time-series gate that samples SQLite apply-lag / sqlite_high_water across the run and fails if lag grows unbounded or exceeds a documented ceiling; (c) add segment-density and object-PUT gates (mean/max commands-per-segment within a documented bound; objects_put within expected range for resident); (d) fold all new gates into bars_met.
NON-SCOPE: the workload/scale harness (child 'Hybrid-async perf harness'); the hot-path fix (child 'Close hybrid-async hot-path gap'); running the release matrix and emitting final docs (child 'Emit release-grade hybrid-async evidence'); release version bump.
DEPENDS ON: child 'Hybrid-async perf harness' (gates operate on its cells).
GATE SUBSTITUTION: `cargo test -p pqueue-server` is the test gate; `cargo fmt --check` is the pre-commit gate.
bead.acceptance:
1. New Test performance_object_log_hybrid_attribution asserts each hybrid_attr_*_ms field is emitted, non-negative, and sums to within tolerance of measured hot-path wall time: `cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_attribution -- --nocapture`.
2. New Test performance_object_log_hybrid_bounded_debt_gate asserts the SQLite apply-lag time-series is bounded and non-growing and that the gate is a bars_met input: `cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_bounded_debt_gate -- --nocapture`.
3. New Test performance_object_log_hybrid_segment_density_gate asserts the mean/max commands-per-segment and objects_put gates feed bars_met: `cargo test -p pqueue-server --release --test performance_object_log_hybrid_tests performance_object_log_hybrid_segment_density_gate -- --nocapture`.
4. `rg -n 'hybrid_attr_|bounded_debt|segment_density' crates/pqueue-server/tests/performance_object_log_hybrid_tests.rs` succeeds and the emitted ledger keeps hybrid_ack_p99_vs_inmemory_ratio and hybrid_claim_finalize_p95_vs_inmemory_ratio.
5. Existing performance_object_log_hybrid_smoke still passes and `cargo fmt --check` passes.
